paths.description: Marketplace entry and primary browse/search surface; selected as the homepage archetype.
Representative category/listing template (/all/transport); selected to cover filtering and result browsing.
Representative item/detail template discovered from the normal homepage links; selected to cover media, seller and contact actions.
Login/add-item journey; selected as a primary form and account-gated commercial flow.

findings.summary: Core browser-enforced security headers are absent.
findings.evidence: The headers primitive reported no Content-Security-Policy, Strict-Transport-Security, X-Frame-Options/frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy; only X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff was present.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a restrictive CSP including frame-ancestors, HSTS after deployment validation, and explicit Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy headers. Review whether the 400-day SameSite=None first-party cookies require cross-site delivery.

findings.summary: The entry page exposes an unusually broad third-party tracking surface.
findings.evidence: The tracker primitive observed 114 origins in total, 113 classified as third-party relative to m.avito.ru, with Google Tag Manager, DoubleClick and numerous ad-tech synchronization origins active.
findings.suggestedFix: Inventory every third party by user value and legal basis, remove redundant ad-tech/sync partners, defer non-essential analytics until consent or interaction, and batch first-party measurement.

findings.summary: Startup work produces repeated main-thread long tasks.
findings.evidence: The layout observer recorded six long tasks during the load sample, ranging from 52 ms to 85 ms.
findings.suggestedFix: Profile the startup task attribution, split work below 50 ms, defer non-critical modules and third parties, and schedule lower-priority work after the primary content is interactive.

findings.summary: The requested narrow viewport receives a scaled desktop-width layout instead of true mobile reflow.
findings.evidence: At --viewport 360x800, layout evidence reported innerWidth/client layout width 1016 and visualViewport scale 0.354, even though a viewport meta tag was detected.
findings.suggestedFix: Ensure the effective viewport remains device-width and remove minimum-width/fixed-width constraints that force a roughly 1016px canvas; use intrinsic sizing, fluid tracks and narrow-container adaptations.

findings.summary: The marketplace homepage has no top-level heading.
findings.evidence: The successful rendered-DOM recon returned h1: [] while the page contains multiple navigation and listing regions.
findings.suggestedFix: Add one concise, visually appropriate h1 describing the marketplace/search page, then verify heading levels and landmarks across listing and detail templates.

taskList.title: Reduce and gate the third-party tracking footprint
Make narrow viewports reflow instead of scaling a desktop canvas
Split and defer startup long tasks
Add and validate the page heading hierarchy
